_comment: Caldera Adversary Profiles Inventory - This file contains metadata for adversary profiles used in security training courses. Use 'calctl inventory add <course>' to add new adversaries interactively.

labs.adversary_id: Caldera adversary UUID from Caldera UI
labs.name: Descriptive lab name
labs.abilities: Number of abilities in adversary profile

_usage: Run 'calctl inventory init' to see the example template, or 'calctl inventory add <course>' to add courses interactively.
